themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Missed garbage collection complaints surged to 8 THIS WEEK, a 433% spike above the 1.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting a sudden breakdown in sanitation services across CD316.
evidence: 8 missed collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly baseline (433% increase, z-score: 4.6)
No prior week in the 8-week window exceeded 3 complaints, indicating acute acceleration
Concurrent 66% DROP in unsanitary condition complaints (15 THIS WEEK vs. 44.5 avg) suggests collection delays may be preventing accumulation reports
reporting_angles: Interview residents and building managers about uncollected trash and health impacts; identify which blocks or routes are affected
Contact Sanitation Department to determine cause: staffing shortage, route changes, equipment failure, or other operational issue

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 7 LAST WEEK, a 331% spike above the 1.6 weekly average, pointing to either new illegal dispensaries opening or enforcement gaps in the district.
evidence: 7 cannabis retailer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly baseline (331% increase, z-score: 4.84)
No prior week exceeded 4 complaints, indicating sudden clustering of violations
Constellation CB16 ULURP proposal currently in public review—rezoning may be attracting illicit retail activity ahead of legalization changes
reporting_angles: Map complaint locations to identify if illegal dispensaries are clustered in certain blocks; interview residents about storefront activity
Check with NYPD's narcotics and local cannabis enforcement teams on enforcement activity and known unlicensed retailers in the area

themes_detail.label: Derelict Vehicles Piling Up
themes_detail.summary: Derelict vehicle complaints hit 15 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 179% spike above the 5.4 weekly average, indicating a sudden accumulation of abandoned cars straining street management.
evidence: 15 derelict vehicle complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 5.4 weekly baseline (179% increase, z-score: 4.21)
Prior 8-week highs never exceeded 9 complaints per week, indicating acute acceleration
Concurrent spike in illegal parking (879 total over 90 days, chronically high) and blocked driveway complaints suggests chronic parking/vehicle management failures
reporting_angles: Document which blocks have the most abandoned vehicles; interview residents about how long cars have been sitting and impact on street space
Contact Sanitation Department's tow authority to learn why removal has slowed and whether budget or staffing constraints are delaying intake

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Stress
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints spiked to 18 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 243% increase above the 5.2 weekly average, potentially signaling aging infrastructure failures or blockages affecting multiple buildings.
evidence: 18 sewer complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 5.2 weekly baseline (243% increase, z-score: 4.26)
Prior 8-week peak was 9 complaints; this represents unprecedented recent spike
Concurrent plumbing complaints remain elevated at 509 total (90-day sum), suggesting interconnected water/waste infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents and landlords about backup symptoms (sewage odors, toilet backups, yard flooding); geo-map complaints to identify problem corridors
Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection to request emergency inspection, recent blockage-clearing records, and long-term infrastructure assessment for the district

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage and Overgrowth Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Tree-related complaints (illegal tree damage + overgrown branches) peaked at 10 combined complaints THREE WEEKS AGO, a 1500% spike above baseline, indicating either storm damage or deferred maintenance across the district.
evidence: Illegal tree damage: 4 complaints THREE WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1500% increase, z-score: 8.66)
Overgrown branches: 6 complaints THREE WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (1500% increase, z-score: 8.08)
Both spikes occurred in the same week, suggesting a single triggering event (storm, contractor work, or enforcement wave) rather than independent trends
reporting_angles: Investigate whether a recent weather event (high winds, heavy rain) caused widespread branch falls and illegal trimming by contractors
Contact Parks Department on response timeline and budget for tree maintenance in CD316; identify any ongoing safety hazards from downed or hazardous branches
